text:
Type: bordered flatwoven area rug
Use: anchoring a seating area, dining table or bed; living room, dining room, bedroom, study
Style: rustic, contemporary, minimalist
Materials: tight sisal-look flat weave, fabric edge binding
Colors: dark chocolate brown, black-brown border
Shape: plain rectangle with a fine twill texture and a narrow dark bound border, flat and thin
Feel: earthy, warm, grounded
Goes with: warm wood, leather, cream and beige textiles, black metal; rustic, industrial or modern rooms

product.name: OSTED
product.description: The rug is hard-wearing and durable because its made of sisal, a natural fibre taken from the agave plant.
